essence: A big idea at every scale. Saturated flat illustration on a night field, where the abstract becomes a character, a place or a world you travel through.
explains_by: Personify the abstract: a cell, a coin or a request becomes a small character with a job.
Travel the scales: zoom from the everyday to the very small or the very large, one continuous move.
One governing metaphor, with the place where it breaks said aloud.
Wonder first, then the mechanism: open on the surprising picture, then show how it works.
